[[Lieutenant]] '''Lander''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who flew alongside [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]], [[Captain]] [[Carson Teva]], Lieutenant [[Baysee]], Lieutenant [[Mowaat]] and Lieutenant [[Jensu]] in an [[Incident on Seatos|unauthorized mission]] to [[Seatos]]. After the group detected the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', a massive [[hyperspace transport ring]], exiting the [[atmosphere]] of Seatos, the group flew to cross its axis and block its path. The unit failed and suffered casualties with the ''Sion'' entering [[hyperspace]] through the group, with Lander's X-wing experiencing loss of control.<ref name="Part Four" />

The group would soon land on Seatos' surface and search for Syndulla's friends, [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Sabine Wren]]. Despite a long search, the two were nowhere to be found. Eventually Syndulla's son, [[Jacen Syndulla]], was able to sense Tano's presence through [[the Force]]. The [[Togruta]] was found barely conscious in the ocean with Jensu jumping in to rescue her. Lander assisted his colleague with lifting Tano to safety onto the ramp of Syndulla's ship, the ''[[Ghost]]''.<ref name="Part Five">{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lander first appeared in the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' which was released on [[September 5]], [[2023]]. Lander was portrayed by [[Brendan Wayne]].<ref name="Part Four" /> Wayne also acts as a body double for [[Din Djarin]] in [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''the Mandalorian'']].<ref name="Mando Chapter 1">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}</ref>
